official_source.citation: NVIDIA PhysicalAI-SmartSpaces: Multi-Target Multi-Camera Tracking Benchmark (2026), NVIDIA Research.

official_dataset_characterization.clarification: The overall dataset repository contains predominantly synthetic data; however, scenes Warehouse_026 and Warehouse_027 are explicitly documented and provided as authentic real-world test captures.

facility_independence_classification.governance_rule: NVIDIA does not publish specific physical facility identities or cadastral survey records. Therefore, physical building independence is supported by external provenance but not directly certified by architectural deed.

external_evidence_hierarchy.LEVEL_1: Official NVIDIA source metadata (dataset documentation, schema, statements)
external_evidence_hierarchy.LEVEL_2: Raw video media (Camera_0000.mp4 .. Camera_0003.mp4 container, codec, pixel frames)
external_evidence_hierarchy.LEVEL_3: NVIDIA calibration data (intrinsic, extrinsic, homography, reprojection report)
external_evidence_hierarchy.LEVEL_4: Model-derived observations (YOLO detections, ByteTrack tracks, bbox IoU occlusion proxy)
external_evidence_hierarchy.LEVEL_5: Independent human ground truth (WITHHELD / NOT_AVAILABLE for real-world test scenes)
